author: calebgannon
content:
The two transmogrifants would turn off the other one though so you could only have one of them active at once. 

Those would be timestamped and just last for the turn I think that's ok. But if there was something similar, like an Augment that says "I am a 1/1" then we would have to have the player stack their layers. 

Augments are layered top to bottom. Balanced and tough is the best example you can either make an 8/8 or a 4/8 depending on how they are stacked.

before.author: mononoko

before.author: calebgannon
before.content: (it triggers first, then the other players triggers so theirs resolves first)
